_comment: Curated Google Maps embed presets offered as an alternative to pasting an embed code. Each embedUrl is a ?pb= embed built from the venue's real coordinates (geocoded via OpenStreetMap) with the feature-ID slot NULLED (!1s0x0%3A0x0). That slot only accepts a genuine Google feature ID, and an invented one makes Google discard the coordinates and render an unrelated part of the city — which is exactly what the first three presets in this file used to do. Nulled, the coordinates drive the view. The trade-off is that this form cannot carry a marker pin, so !1d is tuned per venue (977 normally, 488 where the venue needs a tighter frame) until Google draws its own label for the place; that label is what tells the organizer they picked the right venue. Every preset here was checked in a browser at its committed zoom. To add one: either copy Google Maps > Share > Embed a map (gives a real pin, best option) or reuse the shape here with new !2d<lng>!3d<lat> — then LOAD IT AND LOOK AT IT before committing; a venue whose label never appears is not verifiable and should not be added. Keep ids stable and kebab-case; they are not stored on the event (only embedUrl is), so renaming an id is safe.
